name: Ruti
note: Women's clothing boutique from Israel, open in Town & Country Village since November 2009. The store is still listed at 855 El Camino Real #45.

name: Sweet 55
note: Swiss chocolate shop at Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online reported a June 17, 2022 grand opening for the Palo Alto store at 855 El Camino Real Suite 123, and a November 2026 Peninsula shopping guide still lists SWEET55 at Town & Country Village.

name: Coyuchi
note: Organic bedding and home-goods store at Town & Country Village, opened in November 2022. A current listing still places it at 855 El Camino Real, Suite 5.

name: Sushi House
note: Japanese restaurant in Town & Country Village. A current Palo Alto directory lists Sushi House at 855 El Camino Real Suite 158 and dates it to 1988 at the same address; a 2015 student restaurant guide also says it opened in 1988.

name: The Penny Ice Creamery
note: Ice cream shop in Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online reported in February 2023 that The Penny Ice Creamery was expected to open that April at 855 El Camino Real #121, and its August 2023 ice-cream guide listed the Palo Alto shop operating there; the creamery's site still lists Palo Alto hours.

name: Gott's Roadside
note: Burger restaurant in Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online's October 11, 2013 Shop Talk said Gott's Roadside had opened the previous month in Town & Country Village; a current Palo Alto directory lists it at 855 El Camino Real Suite 65 and says it has served there since 2013.

name: Oren’s Hummus Express
note: Quick-service Israeli restaurant in Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online reported the prototype Oren’s Hummus Express would open May 8, 2019 at Town & Country Village Suite 162; a current Palo Alto directory still lists the Express at 855 El Camino Real Suite 162 as a separate location.
